# Agentic First

Canonical site:

- https://agentic-first.co/

Alternate domain:

- https://agent-first.co/ redirects to https://agentic-first.co/

## What This Repo Owns

This repo owns the top-level Agentic First route map. It routes users and
agents into two deliberately separate areas:

- Open Company Information: a separate source-owned publishing platform and
  live MCP service where companies put correct information online so agents
  can use it without scraping or paying a data broker.
- Open Tool Directory: a working directory of agent-friendly tools, field
  notes, useful experiments, and things worth tracking.

Compatibility label:

- Agentics Tool Directory is the former machine-readable label for the Open
  Tool Directory.

The homepage also surfaces a UK / European-company check and a sovereign AI
shortlist. These homepage sections are practical routing aids and field notes,
not legal advice, procurement approval, or compliance certification.

## Product Areas

- Open Company Information: https://agentic-first.co/companies/
- Company/profile MCP: https://agentic-first.co/companies/mcp
- Company/profile machine index: https://agentic-first.co/companies/llms.txt
- Open Tool Directory: https://agentic-first.co/directory/
- Tool Directory machine index: https://agentic-first.co/directory/llms.txt
- Product source: https://github.com/yqup/pitch-mcp
